title: A statement paid in part, and a refund bigger than the statement (review v3 situations 7 and 14, decision H3)
story: One bank and two cards paid in full from it, set up Fri 20 Nov 2026. No holidays are listed for this test. Card Part closes on the 15th and is paid on the 5th of the next month (no move). Its 50,000 statement of 15 Nov is paid with only 40,000 on 5 Dec; 20,000 is spent on 1 Dec. Card Refund closes on the 15th and is paid on the 10th of the next month (moved later). Its 10,000 statement of 15 Nov is paid on 10 Dec, a 30,000 refund for an October buy posts on 25 Nov and 25,000 is spent on 20 Dec. H3: a statement is what was carried over, less payments and refunds since the last close, plus the lines in the cycle; at or below zero it is a credit carried on, nothing is due and no item is made. Every amount is made up.

refund.why: 10,000 (carried) - 10,000 (paid 10 Dec) - 30,000 (refund 25 Nov) = -30,000, a credit: nothing due
-30,000 (credit carried) + 25,000 (20 Dec) = -5,000, a credit: nothing due
